CookieConsent.title: We use cookies
CookieConsent.desc: We use our own and third-party cookies to improve your experience, analyse traffic and personalise content. You can accept them all, reject the optional ones or set them one by one. Closing this notice does not count as accepting: nothing is enabled and you will be asked again.
CookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to work and to protect it from automated submissions. They include the session and form verification. They cannot be disabled.
CookieConsent.functionalDesc: Remember the language and theme you choose. They are exempt from consent because they are the interface personalisation you ask for yourself, so they are always on.
CookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how the site is used, in aggregate, so we can improve it. They are the only optional ones, and they stay denied until you accept them.
